label: Reducer Next Focus precedence: divergence currentFocus > blocked-stop recovery > latest carried-forward question > Follow up on latest finding > first open registry question; promoted idea only when focus empty/resolved; all filtered by rejected-pattern index.

Carried-forward open questions (free-text Questions Remaining / record openQuestions) steer focus but are kept outside keyedQuestions and metrics.openQuestions, so they never raise totalQuestions or block all_questions_answered.
research/inbox.jsonl is the only path that grows the canonical question set; no runtime script or YAML writes it, and the angle-bank origin exists only as a reducer enum.
Question resolution is exact normalized string equality on answeredQuestions, single keyQuestions, or focus text; no semantic or id-based match for rewritten/split questions.

YAML focus pipeline narrows by design: least_explored picks from existing questions, stuck recovery widens only in prompt text, rejected-pattern cache filters, ideas backlog used only when focus empty.

Agent free text under Questions Remaining hijacks the reducer Next Focus (this run: strategy section 11 holds iteration-1 status sentence); the parsed Recommended Next Focus field has no reader found in reduce-state.cjs (grep inference).

Q7: explicit --claude-config-dir on research is rejected loudly, but a configured executor configDir (/deep:research --config-dir, allowed by executor-config.ts for cli-claude-code) is silently dropped: research YAML omits --claude-config-dir while review YAML passes it; research audit record omits configDir.
Q7: ambient CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR still reaches the research child: no guardContext so env falls back to process.env, and the CLAUDE_ prefix is allowlisted for cli-claude-code.

Q7: fan-out unaffected: fanout-run.cjs honors lineage.configDir for any cli-claude-code lineage regardless of loop type and injects CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR after the allowlist; it never calls dispatch-iteration.cjs.
